reason: The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin whose user-facing purpose is to automate approval handling: it adds a persistent composer chip to toggle an Auto Mode and, when active, pre-approves most approval requests through a higher-priority approval listener, while explicitly excluding danger-full-access escalations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的插件，通过界面开关在会话中自动同意绝大多数审批提示，并显示当前模式状态。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a composer switch to automatically approve most approval prompts during sessions while showing current mode status.

capabilities: Automatically accepts eligible approval prompts in the DeepSeek Harness web profile when enabled
Shows a composer-mounted status chip that lets users toggle auto-mode and persists the setting
Intercepts approval request handling in the host plugin pipeline and forwards requests normally when auto-mode is off
Excludes danger-full-access escalation requests from auto-approval

reasons.code: README states the plugin auto-accepts approval prompts (including workspace writes and wider shell commands) when enabled, with a composer chip as the control surface.
README describes registration of the approval/request waterfall listener and behavior: it claims requests with allowed-once when auto-mode is on, otherwise calls next() to keep normal approval flow.
README explicitly states danger-full-access escalations are never auto-granted and remain interactive.
package.json defines a DeepSeek Harness web client bundle with UI runtime dependencies, indicating plugin scope is inside the web interface.
